entries.why: the init lock of Korg's SD driver (tools/patch/script_menu.s SD_INIT_LOCK): on the Sampler set to 1 by 0xC001DB18, read by 0xC001DB3C, cleared by 0xC001DB60; the synth's three functions at 0xC0019440, 0xC0019464 and 0xC0019488 are the same code with the same literal 0xC031BEEC (read in both images). Emulator: never-ready card sets it on both builds
Korg's ACMD41 loop of the card init (Sampler 0xC001AE80, synth 0xC00167A8): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; the out-of-rounds path (mvn r3, #0xc; bl to the lock setter)
Korg's ACMD41 loop of the card init (Sampler 0xC001AE80, synth 0xC00167A8): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; the call that checks the card is in (acmd41_round_hook)
Korg's ACMD41 loop of the card init (Sampler 0xC001AE80, synth 0xC00167A8): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; the return of that call
Korg's ACMD41 loop of the card init (Sampler 0xC001AE80, synth 0xC00167A8): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; the card-present function it calls

Korg's card init (Sampler 0xC001AE04, synth 0xC001672C): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; CMD0, the init's first call behind its setup (bl at Sampler 0xC001AE2C, synth 0xC0016754)

Korg's card init (Sampler 0xC001AE04, synth 0xC001672C): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; CMD8 with the argument 0x1AA (literal 0x1AA in both), bl at Sampler 0xC001AE50, synth 0xC0016778
Korg's card init (Sampler 0xC001AE04, synth 0xC001672C): the same code read in both images, the synth's 0x46D8 lower; the delay called with 10 behind CMD8, bl at Sampler 0xC001AE5C, synth 0xC0016784

the OCR word of Korg's SD driver: ACMD41 sends it ORed with 0x40000000 and stores the answer there; the init zeroes it before its ACMD41 loop; the same literal in the Sampler (0xC001B174) and the synth (0xC0016A9C)
